summary: The review was written against the old 35-line file (parent c1788a8e2), not against 102f1ab. 102f1ab already holds the rewrite from ea5caefae, so most issues were already handled there. I checked each one against the code and the CLI help. #1 (compose missing): already done. The description has the child-image and sidecar trigger, and there is a compose section with the repository location, merge-before-use, compose_list, an agent plus postgres YAML, default selection, the root excluded, the file re-read on every start, and sidecar lifecycle and volumes. No change. #2 (rollback): partly fixed. The steps already ran list, show, save, check and undo. I added that show prints only the Containerfile, so if `files:` lists other files the copy is not a full undo and the folder you save from becomes the next undo. Step 4 now starts with `dyna image show NAME` and running the tool. Undo now re-saves and then refreshes as in step 5. #3 (runtime user): already right. It says user node, uid 1000, and podman/host.go:553 passes --user 1000:1000. #4 (needs and size): the size table and defaults were already there. I checked them against box.Size, the MemMax = 1.5×MemBytes rule in runtime/boxes.go, and session_api.go (medium for a root's child, agent otherwise, then the image's size file). xlarge stays because box.Size accepts it, even though the --help text lists only agent to large. I added that placement does not look for a box-needs device, so the parent should first restrict the room to suitable hosts (dyna-nodes). #5 (save limits): fixed. One compact paragraph now gives the name pattern, regular files only with links dropped (skills.Archive.Folder), 3 MiB packed, 16 images and 128 MiB per room, every stage FROM ${DYNA_BASE}, and downloading large toolchains in a RUN. #6 (overlap): fixed. I cut the refresh-behaviour prose from step 4 and kept only the order. #7 (style): already done. The headings are tasks and the upgrade history is gone. Three lines remain over 100 characters: the description, a quoted error message and a table row. I left them because wrapping them would break them. #8 (inexact commands): already mostly done. The commands are complete and the Rust recipe was gone. The apt recipe now downloads into a fresh ~/deb, checks with `jq --version` and has an undo. I ran it in this box: it downloaded the three versioned .debs and printed jq-1.6. go test ./box/skills passes with no expectation changes. Committed as 988f98934.
unverified: A real `dyna image save` was not run with a changed folder and built on a host. The limits and refusals come from engine/images/store.go and box/skills/skills.go.
xlarge as a `session start` size: box.Size accepts it, but `session start --help` lists only agent, small, medium and large.
